requirement: At least 27 questions covering all nine skills
One validated parameter set for each SFLA skill
Data status must be explicitly recorded
Every predicted probability must lie between zero and one
Every updated mastery value must lie between zero and one
A correct response should not produce less mastery than an incorrect response
The first question must target the lowest-mastery skill
Question difficulty must match the mastery-threshold rule
A new learner must receive all nine fitted prior values
The response and updated mastery must survive a database reload
Interaction and mastery exports must return stored records
